log.msg: Baseline: ui/page.js:18 declares 19 children on one flat line, previewed as one packed masonry wall inside a Doc Overview. No bands, no ordering — table field crumbs pagination card stats badge alert toolbar tags panel tooltip avatar dialog progress menu accordion timeline kbd.

Wall landed. Factored the layouts wall's filter rail + banded grid out into ext/catalog/browse.js — Page.prototype.browse(bands, tokens) — with browse.css taking the two rules out of layouts.css. Both /framework/styles/layouts/ and /framework/ui/ are now one call to it. ⚠ Named browse(), not browser(): Doc.browser() is the Files tab file browser, so this.browser(BANDS) on a Doc drew a file tree where the wall should be, with nothing in the console.

Three measured findings on the band grid. (1) A .page-previews-group spans 1/-1, so every track holds an item and auto-fit has nothing to collapse — the heading had to move OUT of the grid; before that a five-card band drew 8 tracks of 328px, using 1640px of a 2752px wall at 3440. (2) auto-fit, not Page.css auto-fill: auto-fill keeps the empty tracks. (3) ⚠ A LENGTH as the minmax maximum is what the repeat count is computed from, not the minimum — minmax(18em, 26em) gives ONE column at 1280 where minmax(18em, 1fr) gives two. Reverted to 1fr.

log.msg: VERDICT, from the shots, not the score. 3440 is the win and it is the prime objective: width-used 0.561 → 0.943, rate() 85/B → 90/A, and the wall now reaches the right edge instead of stopping at 60% with 1300px of gutter. 1280 gives two columns with band headings; 390 stacks the rail above a one-card column and reads cleanly. STILL WEAK, honestly: (1) within a band row the cards align to start, so a short card (Stat tiles, Toolbar) leaves 100-200px of white under it beside a tall one (Panel, Dialog) — dropping packed/pack() bought even bands and cost the tight vertical pack, and the right fix is a uniform thumb height, not masonry. (2) Four components preview as almost-empty cards because the component IS small — tooltip, menu, crumbs, pagination; that is a demo-body problem, the same one that made two layout cards weak this morning. (3) scale reads 11-12 type sizes and credits 0 at every width; that is the Doc chrome plus nineteen live renders, and I do not believe it is actionable. IGNORED per the brief: measure and contrast, which are the two bands that hold 390 and 1280 at F.

Shots. Before: scratchpad/shots/before-390.png, before-1280.png, before-3440.png. After: ui-after-390.png, ui-after-1280.png, ui-after-3440.png. Component page shape: card-page-1280.png (title, component big on a draggable stage, source, then a Variants wall). Layouts wall re-verified after the factoring: layouts-after-390.png, layouts-after-1280.png, layouts-after-3440.png — 78/C at all three, six columns filling 3440, and its title moved out of the rail to above the row.

Crawled all 19 component pages and all 32 variant urls headless: every one renders its exhibit, zero console errors. ⚠ Two traps paid on the way. The name collision (Doc.browser) cost a debugging round with an empty console. And a backtick inside an md() TEMPLATE LITERAL in ext/catalog/page.js killed the whole module with `missing ) after argument list` — the CLAUDE.md trap, hit exactly as written; node --check on a .mjs copy is what found it, and every edited file is now checked that way.
